newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Chin Foh debuts at 7.50 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Chin Foh debuts at 7.50 rgt.

text.p: Metals concern Chin Foh Bhd listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange Second Board at 7.50 ringgit on Wednesday, compared with a 2.80 ringgit offer price.
The company offered 2.5 million shares in its public issue and an additional 3.60 million for sale both at 2.80 ringgit each. At 0135 GMT, the stock was trading at 7.05 ringgit.
Chin Foh is involved in trading of non-ferrous metal products, making aluminum cladding panels and fibreglass products. It also processes stainless steel coils into flat sheets.
For the year ended January 31, 1997, it reported turnover of 148.70 million ringgit, pretax profit of 18.46 million ringgit, and net profit of 10.13 million or 26 cents a share.
It has forecast net profit of 12.59 million ringgit or 33 cents a share for the year ending January 31, 1998.
